title: Discover and install extensions
description: Add optional downloaders, scrapers, panels, and other capabilities to Cove.

sections.title: Add only the capabilities you need

blocks.text: Extensions add optional behavior without making it part of Cove's core. An extension can provide a downloader, scraper, metadata or automation capability, settings panel, interface panel, or its own User Guide topics.

items: Search the registry or narrow it by type and category.
Review the extension's description and capabilities, then choose Install.
Open Installed Extensions to configure, update, disable, or remove it.

blocks.alt: Cove Discover settings with extension search, filters, and install buttons

blocks.text: Install extensions only from sources you trust. Extensions can contribute server or interface behavior according to the capabilities they declare.

sections.title: Continue with the capability you installed
